_about.title: Sexcapades taxonomy — encapsulated, standalone copy
_about.purpose: A self-contained copy of the Sexcapades kink taxonomy for review (Shel / Eros). This file is the taxonomy ONLY — no app code, no profiles, no ratings. Work from this file; do not pull the taxonomy from the live website, which may be stale or use deprecated storage.
_about.source: taxonomy-hierarchical-stored-ids-round2-2026-11-04.json (stored-ID round 2, landed 2026-11-04). Source file: taxonomy-hierarchical-404.json (SHA b9efd1f5...).
_about.id_system: Stored opaque IDs, assigned once, never regenerated from a name. Category IDs c0001-c0018, subcategory IDs s0001-s0044, topic IDs t0001-t0404. Hierarchy is data, never inside an ID. New IDs are max(existing numeric ID) + 1, and only that operation creates one. Do NOT derive an ID from a name, hierarchy, or array order.
_about.counts: 18 categories, 44 subcategories, 404 topic slots in this file. The live app shows 403 topics (live list view governs). The one slot without a record is 'Direction' (Power exchange) — it has no topic ID (null) and no app record.
caveats: This standalone file does not exactly match the app's live taxonomy in a couple of places (known: Bondage direct topics 9 in file vs 0 live; Tape & wrapping 4 topics in file vs 5 live). The live app list view (403 topics) is the authority; flag discrepancies, never silently resolve them.
A topic's 'risk' flag is per-topic data (exactly one topic is flagged: Edge Play, t0334).
Edging vs Edge play are DISTINCT and must not be merged: Edging = orgasm-control; Edge play = BDSM risk category. FetLife 'Edge Play' maps to Edge play.
Never delete vocabulary — retire an ID, keep an alias, migrate ratings.
